title: Reports
content: The Reports page lets you generate and export summaries across your IVF operations — monthly KPI snapshots, critical alert history, and detailed refill logs — all in one place.

title: Open Reports
content: Click here to open the Reports page.

title: Report Filters
content: Use these filters to narrow your report by branch, date range, and report type. Select the parameters that matter for your audit or review, then generate the report.

title: Report Results
content: Generated report data appears here. You can review the results on screen or export them to CSV for sharing with your compliance team or clinic management.
